hooks.command: bash -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=; policy="$root/scripts/heavy_command_policy.py"; if [ ! -f "$policy" ]; then root=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$root" in */.git) root=${root%/.git} ;; *) root=$(dirname "$root") ;; esac; policy="$root/scripts/heavy_command_policy.py"; fi; [ -f "$policy" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$policy"'
